title: Echo identity classes stay separate from chassis families
summary: Revision 4.10 identifies Echo as disrupted ancient synthetic personal continuity and Ghost Grid as infrastructure ecology. Fragment Repeat Split Drift Residual Corrupt Fusion are symptom flags, not chassis species or hostility labels. Use independent family role equipment motion and condition axes. Do not impose modern Bearframe emblems or chest-ear packages on all Echo or Grid units. Reference dossiers illustrate possible designs, not a finite roster or completed encounters.
